PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 1936/2 – MONDAY, OCTOBER 12, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AMENDED BY LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: EMDS/LND/05/ACQ/02/11. Reference No. of the Ministry of Lands .: 4/3/9/2013/

WS/05. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire servitude over the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land/Survitude to be acquired: Four allotments of land called “Koongahahena and Veheragawamukalana” in Total Extent of about 0.1085 Heectare, depicted as Lot Nos. 1071, 1072, 1073 and 1074 in Village Plan No. 753, Supplement No. 42, Sheet No. 42, and dated 21.05.2015, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Panamura in Diyapotagam Pattuwa Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Embilipitiya in Rathnapura District, Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded as follows.
Lot No. 1071
Name of Land: Koongahahena; Name and Address of the claimants: Mrs. K. A. Heenhamy, Mahakade Gedara, Panamura; Extent: 0.0762 Hectare.
Boundaries: North: Lot Nos. 1064, 1053, 1065 and 1072; East: Lot No. 1072, 402 and 1053; South: Lot No. 1053; West: Lot No. 1053.
Lot No. 1072
Name of Land: Veheragawamukalana; Name and Address of the claimant: Mr. R. K. Jayalath, No. 74/D, We Athura, Panamura; Extent: 0.0138 Hectare.
Boundaries: North: Lot Nos. 1064 and 1065 ; East: Lot Nos. 1065 and 1073; South: Lot Nos. 1073 and 402; West: Lot Nos. 402, 1053 and 1071.
Lot No. 1073
Name of Land: Veheragawamukalana; Name and Address of the claimant: Mr. R. K. Jayalath, No. 74/D, We Athura, Panamura; Extent: 0.0120 Hectare.
Boundaries: North: Lot Nos. 1072, 1065 and 1066 ; East: Lot Nos. 1065, 1066, 1070 and 402; South: Lot Nos. 1053, 1074 and 402; West: Lot Nos. 1074, 1053, 402 and 1072.
Lot No. 1074
Name of Land: Koongahahena; Name and Address of the claimant: Mrs. K. A. Heenhamy, Mahakade Gedara, Panamura; Extent: 0.0065 Hectare.
Boundaries: North: Lot Nos. 1073, 1066 and 1070 ; East: Lot Nos. 1073, 1066, 1070, 402 and 1053; South: Lot No. 1053; West: Lot Nos. 1053 and 402.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat at Embilipitiya on the 18th day of November, 2015 at 2.00 p.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 11th day of November 2015, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
WASANTHA GUNARATHNA, Divisional Secretary, Embilipitiya.
Divisional Secretariat, Embilipitiya, 07th October, 2015.
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: EMDS/LND/05/ACQ/02/07.
Reference No. of the Ministry of Lands .: 4/3/9/2013/
WS/49. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land to be acquired: The allotment of land called “Veheragawamukalana” in Total extent of about 0.0502 Heectare, depicted as Lot No. 1070 in Village Plan No. 753, Supplement No. 41, Sheet No. 41, and dated 21.05.2015, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Panamura in Diyapotagam Pattuwa Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Embilipitiya in Rathnapura District, Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded as follows:—
Lot No. 1070
Name of Land: Veheragawamukalana; Name and Address of the claimant: Mr. R. K. Jayalath, No. 74/D, We Athura, Panamure, Embilipitiya; Extent: 0.0502 Hectare.
Boundaries: North: Lot No. 402; East: Lot No. 402; South: Lot Nos. 402, 1053 and 1066; West: Lot Nos. 1066 and 402.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretary’s Office at Embilipitiya on the 18th day of November, 2015 at 11.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 11th day of November 2015, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
WASANTHA GUNARATHNA, Divisional Secretary, Embilipitiya.
Divisional Secretariat, Embilipitiya, 07th October, 2015.

Notice under Section 7

My No.: 3/2/2/97. Land Min. No .: 4/3/9/2012/IR/29. Description of the land to be acquired: Seven (07) Lots of land situated in Walpaluwa Village in 1351 Mandapola Grama Niladhari Division, Girathalana Korale, Divisional Secretariat Panduwas-nuwara West, Kurunegala District North Western Province in accordance with F.V.P. 1736 Supplement No. 2 Sheet No. 3 of Kurunegala Survey’s General as described below:—
1. Lot No. 71
Name of the Land: Meegahamulahena; Land Use: Canal; Owner: Owner cannot be found; Extent: 0.0020 Hectare.
